title: JustItemBorder
description: Collect new Items to expand the Worldborder
body:
# How it works:
Every time a player picks up a new item for the first time, the World Border expands by one block (can be changed in config). The more you explore, craft, and loot, the more world you have.

## ✨ Why should you download this?
If you are looking for a new way to play Survival or want to host a challenge server for friends, this is the most polished solution available.

🚀 High Performance: Uses a custom, optimized tracking system (no lag, even with hundreds of items).

🌍 Multi-Language Support: Comes with full translations for English, German, Spanish, and French.

🎨 Beautiful Visuals: Features a customizable BossBar (change colors/styles in config), Hex-color support, and clean chat notifications.

⚙️ Smart Filtering: Pre-configured to ignore unobtainable items (like Bedrock, Command Blocks, or technical Blocks) so the challenge remains beatable.

🎆 Grand Finale: celebrated with fireworks and sounds once the item goal ( all items ) is reached.

📊 Progress Tracking: Players can check their progress via BossBar or commands at any time.

## ℹ️ Critical Information & Usage
Compatibility: Designed for Minecraft 1.21+ (Paper/Spigot recommended).

### Installation: 
1. Download the ```JustItemBorderX.X.jar```
2. Simply drop the ```.jar``` into your plugins folder
3. Start or restart your server
4. configure the ```config.yml``` to you liking
5. enjoy playing 💖

### how to update plugin? 
1. Download newest Version from Modrinth
2. Drop the new ```.jar``` into you plugins folder
3. (optional, but crucial to get new features) go into plugins/JustItemBorder and delete every file EXCEPT ```used-items.yml```
4. Restart the Server



### Commands:

```/jib progress``` - Shows your collection progress and a visual bar in chat.

```/jib missing [page]``` - Shows which items you haven't found yet.

```/jib bossbar <on|off|toggle>``` - Hides or shows the top bar.

```/jib language <de|en|es|fr>``` - Switches the plugin language instantly.

```/jib reload``` - Reloads config and languages (Admin).

Configuration: You can edit ```config.yml``` to change the starting size, expansion amount per item, and the excluded items list.

> **Please Note**:
The plugin is not being worked on anymore. 
Thanks for playing JustItemBorder. ❤️
